summary.en: The comma operator supplies its right operand value.
summary.bn: কমা expression আর separator আলাদা করো এবং sizeof দিয়ে টাইপ ও array-এর আকার বোঝো।

notes: C89 includes comma and sizeof. C99 added variable-length arrays and the z output length modifier. C11/C17 implementations may omit VLA support. Ordinary sizeof on int does not evaluate a counter increment in any of these examples.

examples.title: A sequenced comma expression
examples.explanationHtml: The increment completes before multiplication because this comma is an operator. Counter becomes four, then four times two supplies eight. The parentheses keep the low-precedence comma inside the assignment right-hand side.

examples.title: A size question does not increment
examples.explanationHtml: Count remains five because its int operand is not evaluated. The comparison prints one because the queried expression also has int type. This checks the rule without assuming how many bytes an int occupies.

examples.title: Count a fixed array
examples.explanationHtml: The numerator is storage for four int elements; the denominator is storage for one int. Their ratio is four regardless of the implementation int size. The array is local here, so sizeof still sees the real array type.

practice.title: Update then double
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , use a comma expression to increment n then calculate twice n. Print result and final n separated by a space and newline.

practice.title: A three-element array
practice.statementHtml: Read three marks 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print the array element count and newline.
hints: The array has capacity three regardless of the values.

practice.title: No hidden increment
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , query sizeof n++ and print unchanged n and whether the size equals sizeof(int), separated by a space and newline.
hints: The sizeof operand has ordinary int type.

practice.title: Two explicit updates
practice.statementHtml: Read a and b 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , in a comma expression, add two to a, then assign a + 3 to b, then supply a * b. Print result, a and b with spaces and newline.
hints: Each comma sequences the preceding work.

quiz.explanation: The left result is discarded after its evaluation.

quiz.prompt: Does a comma between printf arguments order their evaluation?
quiz.explanation: It is a separator rather than the comma operator.
A C byte has CHAR_BIT bits, and sizeof(char) is one.

quiz.prompt: Which conversion prints a size_t result?
quiz.explanation: The z modifier follows the size_t type rather than a guessed width.

quiz.prompt: Does sizeof i++ increment an ordinary int i?
quiz.explanation: Its expression operand is not evaluated for this non-VLA case.

quiz.prompt: When may sizeof require a runtime bound?
quiz.explanation: VLA sizes can depend on values known during execution.

quiz.prompt: Why can sizeof on an array parameter be misleading?
options: The parameter is adjusted to pointer type
quiz.explanation: The original array size is not carried by the adjusted parameter.

quiz.prompt: The comma sequences an increment before reading n. Which value appears?
quiz.explanation: n becomes three before adding four.

quiz.prompt: An ordinary sizeof operand includes ++. What does n retain?
quiz.explanation: The sizeof operand is not evaluated.

quiz.prompt: A fixed array holds five elements. Which count is printed?
quiz.explanation: Whole-array bytes divided by element bytes gives five.

keyPoints.en: The comma operator supplies its right operand value.
keyPoints.bn: কমা operator-এর ফল ডান দিকের expression-এর মান।

keyPoints.en: A separator comma does not order function arguments.
keyPoints.bn: argument আলাদা করার কমা দিয়ে execution order ঠিক হয় না।

keyPoints.en: sizeof returns a size_t count of C bytes.
keyPoints.bn: sizeof C byte হিসেবে size_t মান দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Ordinary sizeof does not evaluate its expression operand.
keyPoints.bn: সাধারণ non-VLA ক্ষেত্রে sizeof-এর expression চলে না।

keyPoints.en: Array count needs the actual array type.
keyPoints.bn: array-এর element গুনতে তার আসল array টাইপ থাকতে হবে।

examQuestions.question: What value does (a, b) supply?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The value of b. The left result is discarded after its evaluation.

examQuestions.question: Does a comma between printf arguments order their evaluation?
examQuestions.answerHtml: No. It is a separator rather than the comma operator.

examQuestions.question: Read a and b 0 to 100. After Input: in a comma expression, add two to a, then assign a + 3 to b, then supply a * b. Print result, a and b with spaces and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int a, b;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d %d", &a, &b) != 2 || a < 0 || a > 100 || b < 0 || b > 100) {
        return 1;
    }
    int result = (a += 2, b = a + 3, a * b);
    printf("%d %d %d\n", result, a, b);
    return 0;
}

Each comma sequences the preceding work.
